gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-takri: Styro presses its letters together until they nearly crowd one another, a retro, commanding look with barely any gap inside the curves. Noto Sans Takri opens every round form wide and stands tall, so the two never blur.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified even at modest sizes, with terminals that stop well away from the stem. Styro is the one for punch, packing its curves tight and retro, while Noto Sans Tamil handles the quiet, open work of being read.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-tamil-suppleme: Tight, retro and loud up top, then suddenly open. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and a tall middle band, so a long passage feels sturdy and easy to move through beneath Styro's crowded heading.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable is the word for the lower half, but Styro up top is all retro command, its letters jammed nearly shut. Noto Sans Tangsa has wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems, so if the heading shrinks, the body still looks friendlier.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC is built from large open counters and curves that swing outward instead of curling in. Styro does the loud part, retro and commanding with letters squeezed nearly shut, while Noto Sans TC does the easy, welcoming part.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Styro is retro and commanding, its lowercase large and its letters crowded until the curves almost close. And Noto Sans Telugu answers by keeping counters connected to the outside, with a high-set midline for a plain sans feel.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana reads wide and welcoming, with big open lowercase forms. Under Styro's crowded retro heading, its broad channels into each counter let a long passage move along smoothly, with plenty of daylight inside every letter.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-thai: Puffed up like inflated glass beads, Noto Sans Thai leaves its rounded letters wide open and approachable. Styro, retro and tightly packed, is the opposite, and that gap between closed and open is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Professional, with a tall frame. Noto Sans Thai Looped has spacious gaps at its curve terminals, so a long passage looks bold yet breathes, a sharp turn from Styro's crowded, retro, commanding heading.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads soft and rounded, its bowls filling the line like inflated shapes. Next to Styro's tight, retro letters it looks more open still, so give the heading some extra room to stand apart.
